record.body:
## Rationale

The sitting line and the executor are already stored, and title suffixes are how a 60-column pane can show them. That display waits. The estimate the table should eventually show is not stored yet, and a screen built on the sitting line would present session shape as if it were a duration.

## Counter-argument

Both facts are already on the records, so the table could show them in this phase. Waiting couples a small display change to a contract change it does not need.

payload.alternatives: show the sitting line and executor in this phase
payload.choice: Defer dashboard display until task size and executor hours are stored. A later phase shows the sitting line and executor as title suffixes.
